neighbours.label: nouns of typicality or kind: ' example', ' average', ' type', ' kind', ' common' (a typical example, on average, this type of)
fire: A classic example of this style is the old town hall.
On a weekday the shop sells an average of forty loaves.
This type of fern grows only in shaded ravines.
Gout used to be far more common among wealthy men.
My grandmother gave me a perfect example of patience.
What kind of soil do tomatoes prefer in spring?
The students scored well above the national average this year.
For example, the beetle can survive for weeks without water.
quiet: A lovely painting of the old town hall hangs in the lobby.
On a weekday the shop sells roughly forty loaves by noon.
This fern grows only in shaded ravines near the river.
Gout used to strike wealthy men who ate rich food.
My grandmother taught me a great deal about patience.
Which soil do tomatoes prefer when planted in spring?
The students scored well on the national exam this year.
Remarkably, the beetle can survive for weeks without water.

notes: probe: example/average/kind ~0.21-0.23 of max; 'illustration' 0.09. Median may sit near the 0.20 bar.
